name: Picsart
tagline: An all-in-one photo and design editor with AI tools for generating images, retouching and removing backgrounds.
about: Picsart is a creative platform for phone and browser. It has templates for social posts and many one-tap AI tools.
pros: Works on a phone and in the browser.
One-tap AI tools such as background and object removal.
Large template library for social posts.
cons: The free version has ads and watermarks on some exports.
Many tools need a paid plan.
